Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1002
Claimant:
Christopher Shah
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
7-18-25
Claim opened after the insured reported a collision at an intersection while turning left, with the claimant's vehicle
reportedly struck on the driver's side. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will route
through the attorney's office.
7-28-25
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named insured, and the policy was active at the
time of loss. No coverage questions have arisen so far.
8-5-25
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the same general
sequence of events the claimant described to me on first contact.
8-9-25
Photos from the scene and the shop show damage that lines up well with a left-turn impact of this kind. A few older
scratches appear on the lower panels and may predate this loss; I have noted them separately for the appraiser.
8-13-25
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the injury claim is whiplash. The account given matches what the
claimant said in every earlier conversation, with no changes in the timeline or details.
10-13-25
No independent witnesses have come forward. The photos confirm several details of the scene, but nothing in the file
yet speaks to what happened beyond what the parties have described.
10-22-25
Medical records show the reported injury is consistent in type and force with the collision. Treatmnet followed a typical
course and tapered as the claimant improved.
12-9-25
Prior records show a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which resolved fully without lasting effects. I
have asked the medical reviewer to account for this history in the evaluation.
12-11-25
Requested the claimant's prior treatment history through the attorney for completeness. Nothing in the file so far
suggests the vehicle damage occurred before the coverage start date.
1-7-26
Appraiser's estimate ailgns with the described impact. Final determination on the older scratches is pending, and I will
reconcile them with the repair scope.
2-16-26
File is current and awaiting the medical reviewer's note and the appraiser's final scope. Next review is scheduled
once both have been received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
